mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'on_sale' AND audit_status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS onSale, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'reserved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reserved, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'sold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sold, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'offline' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS offline, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected, COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) AS viewTotal, COALESCE(SUM(favorite_count), 0) AS favoriteTotal FROM product WHERE deleted = 0 AND seller_id = #{sellerId}
